offers_products.reason: Manufactures paint sprayers, pumps, valves, spray guns, dispensing and powder coating equipment.

offers_services.reason: Main offerings are manufactured equipment; service and repair support accompany products, not a main line of business.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Homeowners and DIY consumers buy Graco paint sprayers through stores, though contractors and industry are larger.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Professional contractors, automotive, aerospace, packaging and manufacturers buy equipment; distributors and retailers resell it.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue mostly from equipment sales (sprayers, pumps, systems) to contractors and manufacturers, which are periodic purchases, not subscriptions.

cyclical_demand.reason: Contractor, industrial and manufacturing customers can postpone equipment purchases in downturns, as with paint sprayers and finishing systems.

big_ticket.reason: Typical sales are sprayers, pumps, valves and parts, small to mid-sized and repeatable, though some industrial systems are larger.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured fluid-handling equipment and technology, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Sells through distributors to contractors, DIY consumers, and many industrial users; broad, fragmented base rather than mainly large enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: Designs and assembles fluid-handling equipment; manufacturing needs plants but not heavy fleets or networks; moderate capital intensity.

notes: Mix of one-off equipment and repeat parts/consumables sales; recurring answer is a judgment call.
